status: 已完成（2025/12/17）、主要終點未達標。隨機雙盲安慰劑對照，n=105（eDSP 51／安慰劑 54），收案條件為年滿 6 歲、體重 ≥15 kg 之基因確診 A-T 病人，每 21–30 天靜脈給藥一次共六劑；2024/06/24 起執行於美國、英國、德國、義大利、西班牙、丹麥、挪威、波蘭、瑞士等 9 國 20 站點。主要指標為 6–9 歲族群第 6 個月 RmICARS 自基線變化，結果最小平方均數差 −1.30（95% CI −2.77 至 0.18；p=0.085），未達統計顯著；安全性良好（兩組不良事件率約 92–93%，無治療相關嚴重不良事件）。完整論文 2026/08/14 發表於 The Lancet Child & Adolescent Health。登錄最後更新 2026-04-30

en.mechanism:

en.status: Completed 2025/12/17; primary endpoint not met. Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, n=105 (51 eDSP, 54 placebo), enrolling genetically confirmed A-T patients aged 6 years or older weighing at least 15 kg, dosed intravenously every 21–30 days for six doses. It ran from 2024/06/24 across 20 sites in nine countries: the USA, UK, Germany, Italy, Spain, Denmark, Norway, Poland and Switzerland. The primary endpoint was change from baseline in RmICARS at month 6 in participants aged 6–9, which returned a least-squares mean difference of −1.30 (95% CI −2.77 to 0.18; p=0.085) — not statistically significant. Safety was favourable (adverse events in roughly 92–93% of both arms, no serious treatment-related events). The full paper appeared in The Lancet Child & Adolescent Health on 2026/08/14. Registry last updated 2026-04-30

A real-world study comparing troriluzole-treated SCA patients against a matched external control drawn from natural-history cohort data — the evidence source behind Biohaven's NDA claim of 50–70% slowing of progression; that NDA received an FDA Complete Response Letter in November 2025. ⚠️ Observational, non-randomised: efficacy inference is limited by how comparable the external control really is

status: 主動掃描補收（此前未在本平台登錄）。登錄狀態為收案中——Med-SBMA 試驗，多中心隨機雙盲安慰劑對照，每次 300 mg 每日三次口服共 12 週、n=68，日本五家站點（東京、千葉、札幌、下野、吹田）；2025/02/28 起始、主要完成日估 2027/12/31。主要指標＝第 4 週 ALSFRS-R 總分自基線變化。主持人為名古屋大學勝野雅央（SBMA 領域的日本核心研究者，亦為 08/10 收錄之小腦運動學習指標多中心驗證論文共同作者）。⚠️ 登錄自 2025-04-16 起未再更新，「收案中」為主辦方自行維護之陳舊登錄，非查證過的現況。⚠️ 適應症為甘迺迪症／SBMA（polyQ 鄰近圈層）、非 SCA，且屬症狀改善型老藥再定位，不改變病程

en.status: Added by the proactive sweep (not previously registered on this platform). The registry reads RECRUITING — the Med-SBMA trial, multicentre, randomised, double-blind and placebo-controlled, dosed at 300 mg orally three times daily for 12 weeks, n=68 across five Japanese sites (Tokyo, Chiba, Sapporo, Shimotsuke and Suita); started 2025/02/28 with primary completion estimated 2027/12/31. Primary endpoint = change from baseline in total ALSFRS-R at week 4. The investigator is Masahisa Katsuno of Nagoya University, a central Japanese figure in SBMA and a co-author of the multicentre cerebellar motor-learning endpoint paper recorded on 10 August. ⚠️ No registry update since 2025-04-16, so "recruiting" is a stale sponsor-maintained entry rather than a verified current state. ⚠️ The indication is Kennedy's disease / SBMA, the adjacent polyQ ring rather than SCA, and this is a symptomatic repurposing that does not target disease course
